page.overview:
Who is Petey Pacer?

Petey Pacer was first seen on the Oil Rig, welding a torch among several other lemons attacking Finn McMissile on the helipad. He's later seen at the first World Grand Prix race in Tokyo, when he and Acer went to find Mater. Petey was sprayed with lather from a fire extinguisher used by Finn, then turned around the corner and crashed into a police officer. Petey was later arrested by the police officer.

In Cars 2: The Video Game, Petey was seen in the Oil Rig when he and Lemons with Professor Zündapp kidnapped Finn McMissile but Mater Rescued him and chased with Finn to Professor Z, but he crashes with other Lemons and he explodes.

Like all the other Lemons, Petey Pacer was cold-hearted and sadistic where he was willing to commit murder just to achieve any goals in becoming rich. Petey was willing to murder innocent civilians if they become caught in the Lemons' plot where he attempted to kill Mater only to be stopped by Finn McMissile, leading to his arrest.
